identity: SCRIPTURE - Gospel of Luke 14:25-15:32 in the Van Dyck Arabic Bible: the cost of discipleship (the tower, the king going to war, the salt), then the three parables of the lost - the sheep, the drachma, and the prodigal son. Four printed lines = four paragraph blocks; same translation and same genre as doc_32d5d0cbc877, the document that produced 0k.
law: THE VERSE IS THE UNIT (0k). 555 real tokens / 43 verses = 12.9 tokens per unit, essentially the 14 measured on the earlier Luke passage. Inside a verse NOTHING cuts. Every PASS-2 rule I own is suspended: fa of consequence, imperatives, parallel conditionals, wa + a new finite verb, wa-lakin, questions, speech announcers.
reasoning: 0k was written from 18 false cuts on Luke 9-10, and this passage is a minefield of exactly those triggers, so the discipline was to refuse all of them. Suppressed here: the imperative chains in 15:22-23 (akhriju al-hulla al-ula wa-albisuhu wa-jaalu khataman ... wa-qaddimu al-ijl al-musamman wa-dhbahuhu) - E6 is dead in scripture; the fa-consequence chains in 15:14-16 and 15:20 (fa-qama wa-jaa ... fa-tahannana wa-rakada wa-waqaa ala unuqihi wa-qabbalahu, five verbs, ONE verse); wa-lakin at @131, @515 and @543, each inside its verse; and the two speech announcers qailin/qailan which keep their quotations (1v). Two structural checks confirmed the alignment. (1) 15:3 fa-kallamahum bi-hadha al-mathal qailan is a genuine FOUR-TOKEN verse - the shortest unit in the document - and 0k has the precedent (wa-qulu ends its verse when the quotation is the next verse); refusing it would have merged 15:3 into 15:4. (2) The prodigal sons speech is drafted at 15:18-19 and repeated verbatim at 15:21, and the verse division differs between them: the draft splits after wa-quddamak (15:18 | 15:19) while the delivered version runs whole to ibnan (15:21). Two identical strings, two different segmentations - which is a real warning against 0s-style consistency reasoning, and the reason I trusted the verse numbering rather than the wording. Line 4 alone holds 22 verses in 283 tokens, and its rhythm (each verse one narrative move) is the check that kept me from cutting inside 15:20 and 15:29.
